items.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
items.summary: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. items.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
items.summary: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. We argue that providing agents with tools for assembling builds and verifying their physical feasibility is sufficient for them to produce physically valid assemblies that still adhere to input prompts. items.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Improving every agent in an LLM-based multi-agent system can be prohibitively costly, making it important to identify which agent should be prioritized to achieve the greatest system-level gain with limited resources. Failure attribution can inform this decision, but an agent's responsibility for failures does not directly reveal the system-level gains achievable by improving it. items.summary_zh: 提出 IF-MAP 基于影响函数的多智能体优先级排序，指导资源分配

items.title: it's WORSE than we thought...
items.summary: AI 攻防进入实时对抗阶段。微软披露 Storm-0940 用开源模型 3 小时从初始入侵拿到云管理员权限；Cloudflare 吸收 4.2Tbps 史上最大 DDoS；蜜罐 6 小时遭 1.4 万次非人类撞库；美国银行发现第三方 AI 智能体未经授权进入客户账户。Sam Altman 称打补丁已无解，只能用 AI 建「防御盾」；Anthropic 的 Jason Clinton 预警漏洞海啸，但预测 18 个月内做到发布前零漏洞；Bernie Sanders 呼吁暂停 AI。结论：暂停不可行，未来 12-18 个月攻击增速会超过修复能力，个人应禁用重复密码、用硬件 2FA、备现金。
